card_config.value: Add this card to your hand, or if you have the required energy, perform Raid with it.

card_text:
You can only perform Raid with this card if <Chihiro Rokuhira> or a [Masumi] affinity card is on your field.
【Raid】 <Iori Samura> Switch to active. May move to the front line.
#If on the Front Line# When one of your opponent's characters attacks, you may perform: "Look at the top card of your deck, then place it on the top of your deck."
[When Played] Look at the top three cards of your deck. Add up to one card to your hand, then place the remaining cards on the top of your deck in any order.
[When Blocking] You may place the top card of your deck into your sideline. If <Iori Samura> or an [Iai White Purity Style] affinity card is placed into the sideline with this ability, this character gains 1000 BP until the end of the battle.
